selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main point made at the beginning of this passage about the treatise, despite the five earlier difficulties?
questions.answer: It says the work still has very great value and importance.

questions.question: Who is named as someone who anticipated the treatise before it appeared?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: Which historical setting is mentioned in the note?
questions.answer: Denizli.

questions.question: According to the note, what led to the imprisonment?
questions.answer: The hidden printing of the book led to the imprisonment.

questions.question: What two legal results are mentioned after that trouble?
questions.answer: Acquittal and release.

questions.question: What does the passage say this treatise is in relation to a verse?
questions.answer: It is an explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: How is the treatise organized?
questions.answer: It has an Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What is the content of the Introduction?
questions.answer: Four important matters.

questions.question: What is the role of the Second Station?
questions.answer: It gives the translation of that exposition and the proofs connected with it.

questions.question: What Qur’anic teaching closes the passage?
questions.answer: Human beings and jinn were created in order to worship Allah.

questions.question: In this passage, what overall claim is made about the status of the treatise?
questions.answer: It is presented as a highly significant work with special spiritual importance.

questions.question: Who is presented as having special insight into the treatise before its composition?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What are the two names he is said to have given it?
questions.answer: The Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What was said to help bring about freedom from that imprisonment?
questions.answer: The strength and victory of the truth taught in the book.

questions.question: How does this note function in the passage as a whole?
questions.answer: It serves as supporting evidence for the claim that the earlier prediction was real.

questions.question: What larger point is made through this story of imprisonment and release?
questions.answer: That Imam Ali’s earlier statement was shown to be true.

questions.question: What is special about the First Station compared with the Second Station?
questions.answer: The First Station is in Arabic, while the Second Station gives its translation and proofs.

questions.question: What does the First Station contain?
questions.answer: The Arabic section of the exposition.

questions.question: What distinguishes the First Station from the Second Station in language and function?
questions.answer: The First is the Arabic exposition, while the Second gives its translation and proofs.

questions.question: How does the final verse frame the whole work’s spiritual focus?
questions.answer: It centers the work on the purpose of creation as worshipping Allah.

questions.question: What tension appears at the start of the passage between weakness and worth?
questions.answer: Even though the work has some difficulties and defects, it is still described as very important.

questions.question: What two names are said to have been given to this work?
questions.answer: It was called the Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What are those special names?
questions.answer: The Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What caused the imprisonment according to the note?
questions.answer: The secret publication of the book.
